name: Popover / Filter Builder
description: Filter Builder product scenario for the Popover component.

props.content: Status is Active and owner is Current user.

controls.name: content
controls.description: Floating content. Empty content leaves the trigger without a layer. Tooltip content must be noninteractive.

controls.name: children
controls.description: One trigger element forwarding props/ref, or text rendered as a Button.

controls.name: open
controls.description: Controlled visibility. Changes from the parent do not emit onOpenChange.

controls.name: defaultOpen
controls.description: Initial uncontrolled visibility; later changes do not reset the layer.

controls.name: side
controls.description: Preferred side; may flip when the opposite side has more room.

controls.name: align
controls.description: Logical alignment on the cross axis, following dir or the trigger's direction.

controls.name: sideOffset
controls.description: Additional nonnegative gap in pixels before the content membrane.

controls.name: dir
controls.description: Content direction. Omitted inherits the trigger; auto follows the content.
